title: TimeSeriesAssociation
description:
Metadata linking one time series to the component or supplemental attribute that owns it — the JSON form of a row in infrastore's `time_series_associations` catalog table. A closed set of six types owned by InfrastructureSystems: two static (SingleTimeSeries on a regular grid, NonSequentialTimeSeries on explicit irregular timestamps) and four forecasts. The type decides which timing fields the row carries, which is why each is its own schema rather than one row with everything nullable.

Dense values never appear here. `address` names the store that holds them; content hashes (data_hash, features_hash, timestamps_hash) are store-internal and deliberately absent.
